subject: Regarding your upcoming flight reservation
body: Dear [Recipient], We hope this email finds you well. We would like to remind you about your upcoming flight reservation from New York to London on December 15th. Please ensure that you have all your travel documents ready and arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. Should you have any questions or require assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
